_description: Headline + tagline per unordered indicator pair. Key is the two indicator IDs sorted alphabetically and joined with '|'. The 4 main preset pairs are included here too so picker-reconstructed views render the same way as preset clicks; the presets in stories.json still own the richer 'why' paragraph for tab views.

all_spend_per_capita|poverty.headline: All government spending. Does it reach the poor?
all_spend_per_capita|poverty.tagline: Every province-attributable PhilGEPS contract per capita against poverty incidence. 82 provinces, 2014 to 2024.

all_spend_per_capita|gdp_per_capita.headline: Does spending follow wealth, or chase poverty?
all_spend_per_capita|gdp_per_capita.tagline: All PhilGEPS spend per capita against per capita GDP. Three years of provincial GDP data, 2022 to 2024.

dpwh_spend_per_capita|poverty.headline: Twelve years, two trillion in roads. Did poverty improve?
dpwh_spend_per_capita|poverty.tagline: DPWH spend per capita against poverty incidence. 82 provinces. 2014 to 2024. Hit play, or use the arrow keys.

gdp_per_capita|poverty.headline: Wealthier provinces, lower poverty?
gdp_per_capita|poverty.tagline: Per capita GDP (constant 2018 PHP) against poverty incidence. Three years of PSA province data, 2022 to 2024.

doh_spend_per_capita|poverty.headline: Health spending and poverty. Where do they meet?
doh_spend_per_capita|poverty.tagline: DOH spend per capita against poverty incidence. Does health money land where it is needed most?

infra_spend_per_capita|poverty.headline: Did infrastructure spending lower poverty?
infra_spend_per_capita|poverty.tagline: Infrastructure-tagged spend per capita against poverty incidence. Wider lens than DPWH alone.

dpwh_share_pct|poverty.headline: Are road-heavy provinces also poor provinces?
dpwh_share_pct|poverty.tagline: DPWH's share of total provincial spend against poverty incidence. High share means an infra-tilted procurement mix.

population|poverty.headline: Where do the poor actually live?
population|poverty.tagline: Population (2020 Census) against poverty incidence. Big provinces and small ones, side by side.

poverty|poverty_change_pp.headline: Started high, fell fast? Or started low and stalled?
poverty|poverty_change_pp.tagline: Poverty incidence against the 2018-to-2023 change. Top-left is poor but improving. Bottom-right is well-off but slipping.

all_spend_per_capita|dpwh_spend_per_capi.headline: How much of every province's spending is roads?
all_spend_per_capita|dpwh_spend_per_capi.tagline: DPWH spend per capita against all PhilGEPS spend per capita. The closer to the diagonal, the more DPWH dominates.

dpwh_spend_per_capita|gdp_per_capita.tagline: DPWH spend per capita against per capita GDP. Three years of provincial GDP data, 2022 to 2024.

doh_spend_per_capita|dpwh_spend_per_capi.tagline: DPWH spend per capita against DOH spend per capita.

dpwh_spend_per_capita|infra_spend_per_ca.tagline: DPWH per capita against all infrastructure-tagged spend per capita. Gaps mean non-DPWH infra is moving the needle.
